info.name: Leave Request Mobile API
info.description:
Mobile flow for employee leave requests.

== THE LEAVE DROPDOWN ==
The "available leaves" dropdown in the create-request screen is fed by request #1 (GET /my/leave-policies). It returns ONLY the leave policies assigned to the logged-in employee, each with its live yearly balance. Use "name" as the dropdown label (recommended: show "available_days" next to it, e.g. "Annual Year — 14 days") and submit that item's "leave_policy_id" when creating the request (#2). Policies the employee is NOT assigned to will never appear here — assignment is done by HR from the user profile (web).

== FLOW ==
1) GET /my/leave-policies → fill the dropdown (also gives you per-policy flags: requires_attachment, min_notice_days, day_calculation_type)
2) POST /leave-requests with the chosen leave_policy_id → request enters the approval workflow (auto-approved instantly if the company has no approval steps configured)
3) GET /leave-requests/my → track status (pending قيد الانتظار / approved مقبول / rejected مرفوض / cancelled ملغي)
4) GET /leave-requests/{id} → details incl. workflow.in_progress + rejection_reason
5) POST /leave-requests/{id}/cancel → cancel while still pending (owner only)

== NOTES ==
- Balances renew every calendar year automatically: pass ?year= to request #1 to see another year's balance. No reset action is ever needed.
- Once approved, the leave days show as "اجازه" in the attendance calendar / today API and count as used in reports — nothing extra to call.
- Response envelope: { "code", "message", "payload" } (+ "pagination" on paginated lists).
- Errors: 422 with { "message" } for business-rule failures (insufficient balance, overlap, min notice, missing attachment, policy not assigned) — display "message" to the user.

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}, X-Tenant: {{tenant_id}}, Accept: application/json, Accept-Language: {{language}}

query.description: Optional. Integer 2000-2100, default current year. Balances are per-year and renew every January automatically.

request.description: THE DROPDOWN SOURCE. Returns the leave policies ASSIGNED to the authenticated employee with live yearly balances — this is exactly the set of leaves available for him to request. Map each item: dropdown label = "name" (+ "available_days"), submitted value = "leave_policy_id". Read the flags per selected policy to adjust the form: requires_attachment=1 → show upload field; min_notice_days>0 → disable too-early dates; day_calculation_type (work_day|calendar) → hint how days are counted.

request.description: Creates the request for the authenticated employee using the leave_policy_id picked from the dropdown (#1). total_days is computed server-side per the policy day_calculation_type. The approval workflow starts immediately: if the company configured approval steps, status stays "pending" (workflow.in_progress=true); otherwise it is auto-approved. On 422, display the returned "message" (insufficient balance / overlap with existing request / min notice / missing required attachment / policy not assigned).
